description: This file defines the CursoService class, which provides core business logic for managing Curso entities in the application. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving courses, and interacts with the CursoRepository for persistence. The class uses Spring annotations for dependency injection and service designation.

classes.name: CursoService
classes.description: Service class providing core functionalities for Curso entities, such as create, update, delete, and retrieve.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Curso entity based on data from CursoDto after ensuring no duplicate course name exists.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Curso entity with new data from a Curso object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Curso entities from the repository.
